title: Popper — preference by elimination
description: Stop interviewing your coding agent. Strike the wrong behavior; Popper compiles what survives into local rules.
social_image_alt: Two contrast cards; one is crossed out in red as 6,561 preference hypotheses narrow into rules.
hero_title: Don't answer setup questions. Strike the wrong side.
hero_body: Popper shows two concrete agent behaviors. Cross out the wrong one; surviving preferences compile into local, executable rules.
proof_line: 15 strikes · no runtime LLM or external network · deterministic replay
hero_image_alt: A contrast pair with one red strike, followed by 6,561 hypotheses narrowing into rules.
demo_summary: Watch a real 15-strike session (1.6 MB GIF)
demo_alt: The real Popper browser UI progressing from zero to fifteen strikes, compiling local rules, and completing the session.
mechanism_title: A proof you can inspect, strike, and replay.
mechanism_intro: Two transcript candidates make the decision visible. One fails; the surviving side becomes an executable local rule.
left_transcript: Before fixing pagination, ask whether tests and cleanup are in scope.
right_transcript: Fix pagination, run focused tests, then report the change and evidence.
rail_caption: The search narrows by evidence, not by a hidden guess.
rule_text: Act first, run focused verification, then report the change and evidence.
start_title: Three steps from archive to an owned proof.
step_one_body: Download the plugin ZIP, SHA256SUMS, and verifier together. Verify before extracting into a fresh versioned directory; the README includes PowerShell.
step_two_body: Install the extracted package from your local marketplace.
step_three_body: Open Popper, enable it, then inspect status.
boundaries_title: Useful because the edges are explicit.
boundary_local_body: Your files, your install, your decision to activate.
boundary_runtime_title: No runtime LLM, external network, or telemetry
boundary_runtime_body: The browser uses loopback HTTP; the session makes no model call, remote request, or analytics trail.
boundary_replay_body: Recorded strikes stay ordered and replay to the same result.
boundary_activation_body: Enable only when ready; rollback removes only Popper's owned import line.
share_title: A short sentence, backed by the README.
share_sentence: Popper falsifies the wrong side locally, then turns the survivor into an executable rule.
footer_note: Built for inspectable, local preference convergence.
